## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the black stand with angled display, rotate it facing you, then put it back on the table.

Task description: Pick up the black stand with the tilted display surface on the left side of the table, turn it so the display faces the robot, then set it back down.

Success criteria: The stand base lies flat on the table, its display face directly toward the robot, retaining its normal standing inclination without extra sideways tilt or rotation. Both grippers are open and have released the stand.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping just inside a straight section of the display-board edge, contacting its front and back with separate fingers. Avoid sharp corners and the base joint to provide enough pad contact and entry clearance.
- The initial side view shows only part of the stand. Before closing, use a view that reveals the grasp region to confirm the fingers surround the panel. Adjust the opening for panel thickness and clearance to avoid an empty grasp or sweeping collision.
- When changing orientation, keep the entire base off the table and leave room for its outer corners to turn. Prefer rotation about the vertical axis to avoid scraping the table and making the stand slip inside the gripper.
- During placement, let the base contact and bear weight on the table steadily before releasing. Withdraw in a direction away from the display board to reduce tipping from unsupported release or withdrawal.
